description: REEF3D::HYDRO on 2 ranks: a valley of 200 m x 60 m (4 m cells, slope 0.1, channel 4 m wide, side slopes 0.4, Manning n 0.0445) with a point source of 60 m3/s at its head (R 40) and 30 mm/h rain (R 10), free outfall, semi-implicit (A 210 13, flow Courant number 0.8): fast flow in the channel, sheet flow on the banks; the coarse version of the flume of HYDRO/validation/14_benchmark_anuga. The stage state of fast flow (A 236 1) in 2D, with the weights and the momentum of t^n of the cells across the rank boundary.
